description: This file is an HTML webpage that implements a database visualizer UI with embedded JavaScript for client-side interactions. It serves as the frontend for browsing databases, listing tables, and viewing data.
external_files: CSS styles embedded within the HTML
Client-side JavaScript functions within script tags
external_methods: fetchData (fetch API calls to backend endpoints)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of databases from the backend API

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refresh button handler that reloads the database list and resets UI state

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses database to show/hide tables, loads tables list

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of tables for a selected database

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders tabular data including headers, rows, and handles wide/long content

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, managing nulls, objects, and long strings

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses long/complex cell content on click
